Privacy Policy

Updated October 30, 2026.

Your estimate details

The estimate builder keeps your entries in the current page’s memory. It does not submit them to a website server or save them in browser storage. Opening a text message passes the composed details to your device’s messaging app. You choose whether to send it.

Calls and text messages

When you call or send a text, the information is handled through your phone and messaging providers and the business’s ordinary communications. Contact E&S at (619) 507-4947 with questions about information you have shared directly.

Site hosting and third parties

The hosting provider may process ordinary technical request data needed to serve this site. The map loads from OpenStreetMap and sends technical information such as your IP address to that provider. Instagram opens only when you follow its link.

Local preferences

A session-only flag remembers whether the introductory animation has played. This site does not add advertising trackers or analytics scripts.
